newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials higher in early trading.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials higher in early trading.

text.p: Wall Street stocks rebounded from Wednesday's bout of profit-taking on Thursday and headed higher in early trading, bolstered by a steady bond market and some favorable earnings reports.
The Dow Industrials rose 10 to 6,737 at the start. The Nasdaq Composite was up eight at 1,341, while the S&P Index rose two at 769.
The 30-year bond was up 11/32 to yield 6.77 percent as Wall Street opened.
